summary: Iteration 80 — Frontend onboarding redesign verified end-to-end on the /onboarding route as member_first (Alex). All 11 steps render with correct progress labels ('Step X of 11 · About a minute'), correct copy, correct testIDs, and correct button semantics. George's butterfly (testID onb-george-butterfly) animates in and lands top-right on the Welcome step; the speech bubble (testID onb-george-bubble) fades in, mentions Georgia, and contains the correct intro copy with real curly apostrophes / em-dashes (no raw \u2019 or \u2014 leaks in the DOM). The 🦋 Need a hand? card (testID onb-need-help-card) is present. Primary CTA reads exactly 'Let’s take a quick tour' with a curly apostrophe. All six tour pages appear in the specified order: Coffee Lounge → Find Friends → Friendship Groups → Local Events → Games Hub → Community Notice Board, each with a George bubble, an emoji hero card, a warm paragraph, and the footer 'Take your time — tap Next when you’re ready.' Accessibility (Step 8), Privacy (Step 9), Interests (Step 10) and Suggested Groups (Step 11) each show the correct one-line George intro. Skip button is correctly shown ONLY on Interests + Groups. Back button decrements the step index correctly. Suggested-groups endpoint fires on entry to step 10. Wizard completion sets AsyncStorage flag george.needs_georgia_hint='1' during the celebration, redirects to /home within ~1.6s, and the first George returning-greeting on /home reads the Georgia-mention line ('If you’d ever prefer to chat with Georgia instead of me…'). The hint flag is removed after consumption; a subsequent reload does NOT mention Georgia (one-shot consumption verified). Cleanup of george.* localStorage keys done at end.
observations: Review request specified 'POST to /api/onboarding/suggested-groups' but the implementation uses GET /api/onboarding/suggested-groups?user_id=<id>. The call fires correctly on entry to step 10 (STEP_GROUPS) as required, so functionally this is correct — flagging only because the review request explicitly said POST. No action needed if GET is intended.
Console shows benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) — not introduced by this change; pre-existing across the app.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing member_first / member@friendplace.com.au. Cleaned up george.* AsyncStorage/localStorage keys at end of run.
